description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to land parcel in Madawalamulla, Galle D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810039 and to 13 other land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of multiple "NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO LAND PARCELS" under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. The notices specifically deal with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land parcels, and title determination processes for various districts (Galle, Kurunegala, Mathale). This content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land registration, ownership claims, and title settlement matters.
